name: Glimpse
author: AlteringUX
description: A visual / photographic-memory trainer. Wallhaven scene photos shown briefly, then recalled — first mode Spot the Change (study a scene, then click what changed in an altered copy). Drill on an adaptive difficulty ramp, or let scheduled scenes resurface on an SM-2 interval. Engine + state owned by ~/.local/bin/omarchy-glimpse.

barWidget.description: Scene-memory trainer: shows a streak / due count, reddens when a scheduled review is due; click for the panel. SUPER+SHIFT+ALT+G starts a drill round.
